    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}

    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=18.88, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 2.19 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=16.43, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')

    m.addConstr(6.18 * vars['Var_2'] + 8.7 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.6 * vars['Var_5'] + 2.86 * vars['Var_6'] >= 107.24, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(3.18 * vars['Var_0'] + 5.54 * vars['Var_1'] + 0.07 * vars['Var_3'] + 0.81 * vars['Var_4'] + 2.33 * vars['Var_5'] >= 42.2, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(7.21 * vars['Var_0'] + 3.16 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.01 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.8 * vars['Var_3'] >= 103.99, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(5.57 * vars['Var_0'] + 9.09 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.81 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.87 * vars['Var_5'] + 3.71 * vars['Var_6'] >= 93.02, name='C6')
